title: Hellaphone -- Inferno on Android phones
summary: A short demo of Inferno, the Plan 9 descendant operating system, running on an Android phone as Hellaphone. It shows calls, SMS and data working. The video quality is rough because the camera was held in front of the screen.
why: Shared as a demo of a minimal Inferno-based phone OS and an unusual dumb-phone approach.

quote.text: Here's a short video I threw together demonstrating the phone.
